checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One approximately 8-second widescreen video shows an animated seed sprouting.
must.why: 8s 16:9 clip with a seed that sprouts into a seedling.

must.item: The audible voice-over says the supplied script verbatim, without extra spoken lines.
Water reaches the seed, roots grow downward, and a shoot grows upward toward light in that order.
must.why: A water ripple appears, but no roots are visible growing into the soil. There is no cutaway view. The white stem hangs in the pit and the shoot grows up.

must.item: The corresponding growth stages appear while the narration describes them.
must.why: No audio transcript. The root stage is not visible, so the match is doubtful.

must.item: There is no on-screen text or music.
must.why: No text is visible in the frames. Music cannot be judged from the audio numbers.

exact_text.text: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
exact_text.read_as: No on-screen text is visible. The text was only meant as a voice-over, so this is correct.

faults.what: No cross-section view and no visible roots growing downward. The white stalk dangles into a dark pit, which reads as a root-less sprout.
The seed rises and floats above the leaves in frame 2, and the seed coat sits on a stalk like a mushroom. The growth looks physically odd.
The style is a 3D claymation look, not the flat cartoon the assistant described. The assistant's description is inaccurate.
The soil forms a crater, and the water is just a small ripple. The seed swelling is not clearly shown.

summary: The clip is a nicely rendered 8-second 16:9 seedling growth with no visible text, but it never shows roots growing down in the soil, and the water stage is weak, so the explainer's main sequence is incomplete.
